title: US government takes a 10% stake in Intel

sentences.text: President Donald Trump said on August 22, 2025, that the US government will take a 10% stake in Intel.
sentences.evidence: President Donald Trump said on Friday, August 22, 2025, that the US government will take a 10% stake in Intel Corp.

sentences.text: The government will receive 433.3 million shares at $20.47 each.
sentences.evidence: the government will receive 433.3 million shares of common stock for $20.47 apiece

sentences.text: That works out to about $8.9 billion in total.
sentences.evidence: for a total of about $8.9 billion

sentences.text: No new cash changes hands: the stake is backed by reallocated grant funding.
sentences.evidence: The government paid no new cash; the equity is backed by roughly $8.9 billion in reallocated grant funding

sentences.text: That includes $5.7 billion from the CHIPS and Science Act and $3.2 billion from a Department of Defense program.
sentences.evidence: including $5.7 billion from the CHIPS and Science Act and $3.2 billion from a Department of Defense program

sentences.text: The deal also includes an option to buy another 5% of Intel's shares within five years.
sentences.evidence: the option to buy another 5% of Intel's common shares in the next five years

sentences.text: The stake is passive and comes with no board seat.
sentences.evidence: The stake is passive, with no board seat.

sentences.text: Intel itself warned the stake could cause adverse reactions from international customers.
sentences.evidence: Intel warned that the stake could cause adverse reactions from international customers, investors and business partners

sentences.text: For anyone building on chips, the bigger question is how far governments will go in owning the supply chain.
